title: Adventures with consonant groups
summary: Recognise and write Spanish words with consonant groups such as bl, br, pr and tr.
keyIdeas: A consonant group joins two consonants in the same syllable, as in 'plato' or 'tren'.
Some consonants combine with l or r, forming groups such as bl, br, cl, cr, dr, fl, gr, pr and tr.
Say each sound slowly to help you write all the letters without leaving any out.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas la producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: Which consonant group is in the Spanish word «brazo»?
activities.explanation: «brazo» begins with b followed by r, making the group br.
activities.hint: Look at the first two letters.

activities.prompt: The Spanish word «globo» has the consonant group gl.
activities.explanation: Correct! In the first syllable of «globo», g and l combine to make «glo».

activities.prompt: Choose the correctly spelt Spanish word to complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: The correct spelling is «plátano», with pl at the beginning.
activities.sentence: Aisha merienda un dulce ___ en el recreo.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish word to its consonant group.
activities.explanation: Each word has two consonants together in the same syllable.

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish words by whether their consonant group has R or L.
activities.explanation: «primo», «grillo» and «fruta» have groups with R. «blanco», «pluma» and «clavel» have groups with L.

activities.prompt: Find the mistake. Which word is spelt incorrectly in «Hugo lee un libor divertido en la biblioteca.»?
activities.explanation: The correct word is «libro». The letters b and r must be together to make br.
activities.hint: Find the word with letters in the wrong order.

activities.prompt: Complete the Spanish sentence with the correct word.
activities.explanation: The word is «prado», which has pr. «pardo» means brown.
activities.sentence: Nerea vio una mariposa en el verde ___ del parque.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish text carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Reading carefully helps us find information and consonant groups, such as bl in «blanco».
activities.title: La excursión de Clara
activities.text: Clara y Bruno van de excursión al campo. Llevan una cesta con fruta fresca y pan blanco. De pronto, Clara ve un grillo saltando entre las piedras. Bruno le saca una foto con su cámara. ¡Qué día tan alegre!

questions.prompt: Which animal does Clara see in the countryside?
questions.explanation: The text says Clara sees a cricket jumping among the stones.

questions.prompt: Which Spanish word in the text has the group bl?
questions.explanation: «blanco» begins with bl. «Bruno» begins with br and «piedras» contains dr.

activities.prompt: Sort the Spanish words into those with TR or DR.
activities.explanation: «trompeta», «estrella» and «tractor» have tr. «cuadro», «cocodrilo» and «piedra» have dr.

activities.prompt: Put the Spanish sentence in order: who prepares something, then the action, then what is prepared. Place the adjective after «crema».
activities.explanation: The sentence is «La bruja prepara una crema mágica.». Notice br in «bruja», pr in «prepara» and cr in «crema».
